result.title: Sea-Net: A Small and Inherently Interpretable Neural Network for Time Series Classification
result.summary: Traditional time-series classification methods often operate as black boxes, providing a class prediction without indicating which time point or time interval within the series led to that prediction. To improve temporal interpretability, MILLET (Multiple Instance Learning with Temporal Explanation), which combines an InceptionTime encoder with Conjunctive Pooling, provides both classification and temporal explanations. However, MILLET contains approximately 424 K parameters, making it unsuitable for deployment on resource-constrained micro-controllers, and it achieves an overall time-series accuracy of 0.888 and an explanation score of 0.681 NDCG@n. We therefore propose SEA-Net, a lightweight architecture using small multi-scale depthwise-separable convolutional TSC encoders and improved Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) pooling heads. Our SEA-Net bottleneck encoder with Top-k pooling achieves 0.931 accuracy and 0.765 NDCG@n with only 41 K parameters. Another variant, using a gated encoder with Top-k pooling, achieves 0.955 accuracy and 0.750 NDCG@n with 62 K parameters. These results demonstrate that lightweight architectures can maintain strong classification performance and temporal explanations while substantially reducing model size. The proposed variants address specific limitations of the pooling strategy used by MILLET, providing a practical direction for interpretable time-series classification on resource-constrained edge devices.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SEA-Net：用轻量多尺度深度可分离卷积编码器配合改进的 MIL 池化头（Top-k、门控变体），在时间序列分类上同时输出类别预测与时间区间层面的解释，并以约 41K–62K 参数取得优于 MILLET（约 424K 参数）的准确率与 NDCG@n 解释分数。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 MIL 池化对「哪些时间点/区间支撑预测」的显式选择与解释评分，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与「LOOK」决策评价提供建模与指标线索；但对象是 1D 时间序列、非生成式 latent 推理状态，迁移可行性需人工核查。
